method: Every stereo SMILES a student page draws (full mocks, Prometric forms, pool, OChem 1000, Ace bank, 2026 set) was drawn with SmilesDrawer 2.4.2 (shared/smiles-drawer.min.js). The configuration each picture shows was read from its 2D positions and wedges (signed volume; the reader agrees with RDKit reading the same drawing on all 25 true R/S centers of a 20-molecule calibration set) and compared with RDKit CIP on the SMILES. Keys were not touched.

summary.note: Default (explicit hydrogens on) is what tools/mock/full.js, prometric-mock.html and games/play.html use; tools/ochem/tree/draw.js drawSmiles turns explicit hydrogens off.

fullMocks.stem: (S)-2-phenylpropanamide is treated with LiAlH4, then aqueous workup. The stereocenter is at the carbon alpha to the carbonyl. What is the major organic product,
fullMocks.note: The stem text names (S) but the stem and every choice are drawn mirrored; the relation between them survives, the stated configuration does not.

fullMocks.stem: (R)-2-bromobutane (shown) is treated with sodium cyanide (NaCN) in DMSO. Which structure is the major product?
fullMocks.note: The stem is drawn right, but both product pictures are mirrored: the keyed SN2 product (S) is drawn as R, and the R choice is drawn as S. A student who applies inversion to the pictures picks the R choice.

fullMocks.stem: Menthyl chloride (shown) undergoes E2 with sodium ethoxide. The leaving Cl is equatorial in the stable chair, so the ring must flip to an all-axial chair before
fullMocks.note: One of the three stereocenters of menthyl chloride is drawn mirrored, so the stem picture shows a diastereomer; the E2 outcome the item tests depends on that geometry.

fullMocks.stem: (S)-2-phenylpropanoyl chloride (drawn) is treated with methanol. The bond to the stereocenter is never broken. What is the major product?
fullMocks.note: The stem text names (S) but the stem and the choices are drawn mirrored; the relation survives, the stated configuration does not.

fullMocks.stem: A single enantiomer of 2-phenylpropanoic acid (stereocenter shown) is heated with methanol and catalytic H2SO4. Which structure is the major product, accounting
fullMocks.note: The stem acid is drawn right, but the keyed retention product is drawn as its mirror image and the inverted choice is drawn as the retention product. A student who reasons from the pictures picks the inverted choice.

fullMocks.stem: Optically pure (R)-3-phenylbutan-2-one (shown) is stirred in aqueous NaOH and then re-isolated. The alpha carbon bearing the phenyl group is the stereocenter. W
fullMocks.note: The stem text names (R) but the stem is drawn as S. The key (racemization) does not depend on it.
